meaning_first.independence_note: Fresh reviewer context. Before persisting these findings, read only the two assigned source-only packets and project review instructions. Did not open author batches, author notes, starters, models, criteria, previous reviews or the catalogue.

tone_balance.scope_note: This packet contributes 2 lightly humorous items among its 9 items. Across both reviewed open-task packets there are 15 ordinary items and 3 lightly humorous items. The coordinator must independently add the other 18 A1 items and check five lightly humorous tasks across the 36-item program. This packet stays within the small-batch upward-rounded cap of two.

meaning.situation_summary: Modibo stands in a kitchen and holds an ordinary cup.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Name the visible object and the room in a short spoken description.
meaning.coherence_explanation: The cup is plainly held in his hands. The sink and cupboard establish a kitchen, so the two questions refer to compatible facts in one scene.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: The prompt explicitly requests an oral picture description with ‘Vertel het’. This fits the A1 picture-description task. It does not require a fictional in-scene recipient or an invented reason to send a message.
meaning.tone_reason: The cup has normal proportions and is used normally. Holding it with both hands adds no comic premise.

items.picture_text_check: The brief and Dutch alt both identify the cup and kitchen. These are appropriate equivalent pictured facts for accessibility.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The visible title does not supply either requested picture fact.

meaning.situation_summary: Roos and Sabrina smile while sharing one enormous blue coat in a clothing shop.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Describe the number of people wearing the coat and its colour.
meaning.coherence_explanation: The clothing-shop setting and one shared oversized garment make a coherent visual joke. Exactly two heads and two pairs of legs support the count; a single continuous blue garment supports the colour question.
meaning.contrivance_check: pass: the prompt and pictured event support this task without a new event, relationship, motive or object.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: The prompt explicitly requests an oral picture description with ‘Vertel het’. This fits the A1 picture-description task. It does not require a fictional in-scene recipient or an invented reason to send a message.
meaning.tone_reason: Two adults sharing one enormous coat is a deliberate visual surprise.

two_tiny_goals: Say how many people wear the coat.
items.picture_text_check: The brief and alt agree that two women share one blue coat. The alt correctly keeps equivalent pictured facts for accessibility.

title_and_cue_check.finding: The title ‘Samen in een jas’ cues the first goal by stating that people share the coat. A neutral location title would leave the number to the picture.

required_revision.reason: Remove the sharing cue before asking the learner how many people wear the coat.
